decision_reason: The measured R7 deviation is reproducible and high confidence, but the smallest plausible correction surface is server/src/platform/security/**, which REQ-20260818-035 explicitly marks read-only. Correcting it without a new authorized requirement or scope revision would violate the approved module boundary.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: JwtAuthenticationFilter calls AuthService.me() twice per authenticated request, and AuthService.me() hydrates identity data and generates an avatar presigned URL, adding sufficient fixed overhead to push the unread-count endpoint above 200ms P95 under 200-client load.
supporting_evidence: JwtAuthenticationFilter.java calls authService.me(user) separately for roles and permissions.
The load test had zero request errors, MySQL Max_used_connections of 21 and Threads_running of 2, which does not indicate notification-query or connection-pool saturation.
JWT requests failed before valid MinIO credentials were restored, confirming that ordinary authenticated API requests currently depend on avatar URL generation.
causal_assessment.falsifier: Request profiling or an authorized A/B implementation shows that removing duplicate identity hydration and per-request avatar presigning does not reduce the identical load-test P95, or demonstrates that the unread-count SQL itself dominates latency.

control_action.gain: low until authorization and profiling, then medium for a bounded correction
control_action.target: Authenticated-request identity hydration in JwtAuthenticationFilter and AuthService
write_scope: a separately approved requirement and codex-task-scope.yaml
invariants: Do not weaken JWT validation, tenant isolation, role or permission enforcement.
Do not remove the avatar URL from the explicit /auth/me response contract.
Do not introduce SSE, WebSocket, cache, queue, schema or index changes under the notification-latency requirement.
Keep the existing notification endpoint and DTO unchanged.
control_action.impact_limit: Only eliminate duplicate or unnecessary identity enrichment on ordinary authenticated requests; do not redesign authorization or notification delivery.
control_action.rollback: Restore the pre-correction security filter and AuthService implementation from the bounded correction diff.
correction_check: Run all platform security and full backend tests.
Verify /api/auth/me still returns the expected roles, permissions and avatar URL.
Verify authenticated tenant and permission enforcement on representative protected endpoints.
Rerun /private/tmp/req035-load-test.mjs with 200 clients and 60 rounds; require zero errors and P95 <= 200ms.
Repeat at least 20 event-to-bell runs and retain P95 <= 2s.
control_action.route: new authorized requirement or explicit scope revision, then planning and executing

residual_risk: R7 remains 21.407ms above its response-time P95 threshold in the measured local environment.
The primary two-second event-to-bell objective is already satisfied at approximately 945ms P95 and is not blocked functionally by this capacity deviation.
No convergence report may claim pass while F-0001 remains escalated.
